text:
anya: quick check before I open the onboarding PR — the model bundle points to a `gs://` location for weights but our serving gate checks expect `s3://` assets. who owns moving/aliasing these?

sam: I can own the aliasing. which model is this exactly? is it 'mistral-mini-x'?

anya: yes, 'mistral-mini-x' (team asked for small variant). CI failed in the config lint stage complaining about missing defaults for `context_window` and a tokenizer mismatch. attaching the snippet from the repo.

priya: fyi tokenizer quirk — pack token order differs from our expected canonical ordering. the repo config has:
```json
{
  "tokenizer": {
    "pad_token_id": 0,
    "eos_token_id": 2,
    "special_tokens": ["<pad>", "<unk>", "</s>"]
  },
  "context_window": null
}
```
But the tokenizer binary we validated returns `pad=1` and `eos=2`. that causes off-by-one in generated logits when serving with `use_fast=False`.

mike: quick mitigation: add a lint rule that checks tokenizer IDs against the tokenizer artifact (call `python tools/token_check.py --tokenizer path/to/tokenizer`). also set a schema default for `context_window` to 2048 in the config validator so CI doesn't fail on null.

jordan: for aliasing assets, we should not rewrite weights in place. sam, can you create an s3 pointer that forwards to the gs asset (or copy to `s3://redwood-models/mistral-mini-x/v1/weights.bin`) and then update `assets.location` to a stable s3 path? we'll want immutability for dedupe.

sam: yep, can do s3 alias + lifecycle. will need an ownership tag and invoice to track storage cost. I'll create the s3 object with tag `owner=eng-ml/mistral` and update the asset registry.

deploy-bot: CI schema-lint job failed on branch `feature/mistral-onboard` — errors: `config.context_window: null`, `tokenizer.pad_token_id mismatch with tokenizer artifact` (see logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4523).

anya: thanks. plan: sam will create s3 pointer by EOD, I'll open PR to set `context_window: 2048` and add a test that asserts tokenizer ids match the artifact, priya/mike can review the lint rule PR. jordan — can you add a quick canary rollout policy to the serving config so we don't start full traffic until we've sanity-checked outputs?

jordan: yep, I'll add a `rollout: { strategy: "canary", percent: 5, watch_metrics: ["latency","perplexity_delta"] }` in the serving config and a fallback to the smaller quantized variant.

mike: nit — make the lint error message actionable, e.g. "tokenizer.pad_token_id (0) != artifact.pad_token_id (1) — run tools/token_align.sh or set override in config.tokenizer_map". small help text avoids noisy back-and-forth.

priya: once sam updates the asset pointer, I'll run a local `serve --model-config config.json --check-tokenizer` pass and paste results here.

anya: perfect. I'll create the PR and ping this thread. thanks all :thumbsup:
